theater: 烏蘇馬辛塔河畔皮達斯內格拉斯

battle.name: 第十三次「星際大戰」
battle.theater: 烏蘇馬辛塔河畔皮達斯內格拉斯
battle.brief: 公元781年3月31日（長紀曆9.17.10.6.1），皮達斯內格拉斯統兵在烏蘇馬辛塔河上游擊敗一個未留名的政權，記為第十三次「星際大戰」，是瑪雅有紀錄的最後一場星戰。卡面的科林斯青銅盔是希臘兵器，正面全罩的銅盔未到過中美洲；位置上相應的，是瑪雅貴族戰士以棉甲與戰鬥面具包住頭面。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries:
這場星戰發生在八世紀末葉瑪雅世界的西部，烏蘇馬辛塔河中上游的河谷裡，交戰兩方一邊是皮達斯內格拉斯，一邊是碑銘未留名的政權。皮達斯內格拉斯（瑪雅名約克興，Yokib'）自公元603年起由同一王朝執政，築在佩滕北部連串山丘之上，居高臨下扼住烏蘇馬辛塔河與聖佩德羅河匯流處的門戶，是當地實力最強的城邦之一。國王稱阿豪（ajaw），之下是受其節制的次級貴族沙哈爾（sajal），再下是各家族的家臣戰士與城邑民兵，征戰多由國王與家臣隊伍親自率領。它與上游約四十公里的亞什奇蘭既有聯姻也有競爭，七百多年來對塔巴斯科低地的中介貿易權一直維持不墜，黑曜石、翡翠、食鹽、可可與無刺蜂蜜經此轉手，累積的財富正是養得起城防、工匠與石刻隊伍的底子。
對手一方的政權名沒有在殘存碑文中留下。瑪雅人寫勝仗時常把敵國略去：644年托爾圖格羅的石碑只寫「血聚成池、骨堆成山」，672年帕倫克那次星戰的敵手同樣無名，因此這場781年的戰事能確定的只有一件事，就是皮達斯內格拉斯一方取勝。八世紀末的瑪雅世界並非只有這兩方：南方低地經歷了蒂卡爾被納蘭霍打垮、多斯皮拉斯覆亡、塞伊瓦爾淪陷等連串震盪，中美洲的權力重心向佩滕北部轉移，亞什奇蘭與納蘭霍正沿烏蘇馬辛塔河上下游崛起。皮達斯內格拉斯選在此刻向一個無名鄰邦出手，說明它要在舊秩序崩解的縫隙裡，把西部走廊上的競爭者逐一壓下去。
countriesEn:
This star war was fought in the closing decades of the eighth century, in the valley of the middle and upper Usumacinta in the western Maya world. One side was Piedras Negras; the other was a polity whose name was never written down. Piedras Negras (Maya name approximately Yokib') had been ruled by a single dynasty since AD 603. The city stands on a series of hills in northern Petén, overlooking the junction of the Usumacinta and the Río San Pedro, and therefore commanding the gateway of the western river corridor; it was among the strongest city-states of the region. Its ruler was the ajaw; below him stood subordinate lesser lords, the sajal; below them the household warriors of individual lineages and the commoners of the towns. Campaigns were normally led by the king and his own retainers in person. Piedras Negras was bound to Yaxchilan, some forty kilometres up the same river, by marriage as well as by rivalry, and for seven centuries it kept its mediating role in the trade with the Tabasco floodplain, where obsidian, jade, salt, cacao and stingless bee honey passed through its hands; that traffic was the wealth that paid for fortifications, craftsmen and stone carvers.
The name of the opposing polity does not survive in the inscriptions, a normal feature of the way the Maya wrote down their victories. The Tortuguero stela of 644 says only that the blood was pooled and the skulls were piled, and the enemy of Palenque's star war of 672 is likewise unnamed. What can be established about 781 is that the war was won by Piedras Negras. The late eighth-century Maya world was not made of these two parties alone: the southern lowlands had been shaken by a run of upheavals — Tikal broken by Naranjo, Dos Pilas extinguished, Seibal absorbed — and the centre of gravity of Mesoamerican power was shifting north into northern Petén, with Yaxchilan and Naranjo rising along the Usumacinta. By striking at an unnamed neighbour at this moment, Piedras Negras was clearing the competitors out of the western corridor one at a time.
people:
這場星戰的指揮者，是皮達斯內格拉斯王基尼奇·亞特·阿克二世，即碑銘中的「統治者七」（Ruler 7）。他在780年那次退位之後，於781年以長紀曆9.17.10.9.4完成即位儀式，距星戰之日恰好六十三天。他早年在東組的碑臺上立石，785年又命工匠在J-6室安放「王座一」，是全城最精緻的一件石刻；他在位期間於787年打敗聖埃萊娜，又與波莫納交戰，碑十二畫他與拉馬爾·阿豪、鸚鵡·查克同坐審判從波莫納擄來的俘虜。808年，他被亞什奇蘭王基尼奇·塔布·頭骨三世擒住，形象刻在亞什奇蘭的門楣十上；皮達斯內格拉斯王朝自603年起的統治，就此中斷。
前代君主哈·金·索克在767至780年間執政，780年主動退位，退位之事由「王座一」記下。781年的星戰正落在他退位與新王即位之間，誰掛帥出征，現存材料無法斷言；同一座「王座一」既是哈·金·索克的退位記，也是基尼奇·亞特·阿克二世新王室的開端記，兩代人的紀年在這一件石刻上交接。同期在西部走廊活動的還有亞什奇蘭王基尼奇·塔布·頭骨，他先與皮達斯內格拉斯維持同盟，又在808年成為它的終結者。
解讀這場戰役的學者同樣是戰役的一部分。塔蒂亞娜·普洛斯庫里亞科夫正是從皮達斯內格拉斯成排的碑刻入手，才在1960年代重排出瑪雅歷代君主的年表；「星際大戰」這一名號由琳達·謝萊提出，用以指稱刻有星形字符的重大戰爭，後由戴維·弗里德爾等人以《瑪雅戰爭》推向公眾。
peopleEn:
The commander of this star war was the ruler of Piedras Negras, K'inich Yat Ahk II, the figure epigraphers number as Ruler 7. After the abdication of 780 he completed his accession rite on Long Count 9.17.10.9.4 in 781, exactly sixty-three days after the star war. He set up his stelae in the East Group, and in 785 commissioned the sculptors to place Throne 1 in Structure J-6, the finest single piece of sculpture in the city. During his reign he defeated Santa Elena in 787 and fought against Pomoná; Stela 12 shows him enthroned with La Mar Ajaw and Parrot Chaak, passing judgement on captives taken from Pomoná. In 808 he was captured by K'inich Tatb'u Skull III, ruler of Yaxchilan, whose Lintel 10 records the event; the dynasty that had governed Piedras Negras since 603 ended with it.
His predecessor, Ha' K'in Xook, ruled from 767 to 780 and abdicated voluntarily in 780, an event preserved on Throne 1. The star war of 781 falls precisely between that abdication and the accession of the new king, and the surviving material does not settle who led the army in the field. The same Throne 1 is therefore both the abdication record of Ha' K'in Xook and the opening record of the new house of K'inich Yat Ahk II: the two men's chronology hands over on one monument. The other figure moving along the western corridor at this time was K'inich Tatb'u Skull of Yaxchilan, first an ally of Piedras Negras and, in 808, the man who ended it.
The scholars who read this war are part of its history as well. It was Tatiana Proskouriakoff's work on the rows of stelae at Piedras Negras that allowed her, in the 1960s, to reconstruct the sequence of Maya rulers and their dates. The term star war was coined by the epigrapher Linda Schele for the major conflicts marked with the star glyph, and was brought to a wider public by David Freidel and others in Maya Wars.
kits:
卡面這頂科林斯青銅盔是公元前七世紀希臘世界的產物：整塊青銅衝壓成形，面部全罩，只留兩道眼孔與鼻樑護脊，戴上之後視線與聽覺都受限制，所以重裝步兵只能靠密集隊形互相遮蔽。它屬希臘的城邦制度，與瑪雅戰場毫無瓜葛，這場星戰裡不可能出現這種盔；戰爭列表把它配給此役，是要指出「全正面護頭」這一功能位置。
瑪雅人落在同一位置上的做法，是用棉甲與面具把頭面包住。戰士身穿多層棉絮縫合的護甲，外面再披獸皮或羽織；頭戴棉墊頭盔，富有的貴族還會加上一副以黑曜石、貝殼與翡翠拼成的面具，或以布帛蒙面，只露出眼睛。皮達斯內格拉斯與亞什奇蘭出土的玉質拼面便是此類工藝的實物，臉部因此完全隱去，只留身份由家主與旗幟確認。效果正如科林斯青銅盔：戴的人看不清也聽不明，只能跟隨隊列行動；科林斯人靠方陣活命，瑪雅貴族戰士靠所屬家系活命。
進攻用的長兵器是投矛器（atlatl）加標槍，遠距用弓矢與投石索，近身則用嵌黑曜石刃的棍劍（macuahuitl）與石斧；弓與箭在中美洲要到前古典期晚期、古典期初才逐漸普及，與弓同時流行的是護腕、箭鏃，以及以無刺蜂蜂蜜調味的軍糧。皮達斯內格拉斯倚河立城，靠獨木舟把玉米餅、蜂蜜與石料運進河谷，糧道與河道同向而行。輸的一方所用器械在碑文中無記載，只能推測與對方同類。
kitsEn:
The Corinthian helmet on the card is a product of the Greek world of the seventh century BC: a single sheet of bronze pressed into shape, enclosing the whole face and leaving only two eye holes and a nasal guard to protect the nose. Once it is on, sight and hearing are both restricted, which is why the heavy infantryman can only survive inside a dense formation that shelters him. It belongs to the institutions of the Greek city-state and has nothing to do with a Maya battlefield; it cannot have appeared in this star war. The war list sets it beside this campaign in order to mark one functional slot: full-face protection of the head.
The Maya filled the same slot with quilted cotton and with masks. The warrior wore armour sewn of layers of cotton wadding, covered above by pelt or feathered cloth; on the head went a padded cap, and the wealthy added a mask assembled from obsidian, shell and jade, or a covering of cloth that left only the eyes free. The jade mosaic masks excavated at Piedras Negras and Yaxchilan are the physical type of that craft, and the face disappears completely behind them, identity being confirmed instead by the patron and his banner. The effect is the same as that of the Corinthian helmet: the wearer sees and hears badly and can only act in step with the column. Corinthian hoplites lived by the phalanx; Maya elite warriors lived by the lineage they served.
Long weapons for attacking were the spear-thrower, the atlatl, with its dart, and at longer range the bow, arrow and sling; at close quarters came the macuahuitl, a wooden club edged with obsidian flakes, and stone axes. The bow and arrow reached Mesoamerica only in the Late Preclassic and the early Classic, and travelled with it the wrist guard, the arrowhead, and military provisions sweetened with stingless bee honey. Piedras Negras stood on the river and moved maize cakes, honey and stone into the valley by canoe, so its supply line and its waterway ran in the same direction. Nothing in the inscriptions records the equipment of the defeated side; only the assumption that it matched that of the victors can be made.
tactics:
瑪雅人的星際大戰是一種結果高度確定的會戰：先由王室祭司按金星曆與長紀曆定出出征日，國王率本城家族聯隊與附庸城邦的部隊，沿既定路線進入對方地盤，務求在野外或城前一次解決，俘獲對方君主，再立碑記下勝負並改立新紀元。
這一日的選擇並非隨意。金星在中美洲被稱為「偉大之星」（Chak Ek'），是戰爭之神，德雷士登抄本的金星頁以八十四日的週期表排出金星晨昏可見的時段，配合歷法殿的推算，決定哪些日子可以開戰。學者統計，現存星戰日期中約七成落在金星的昏星出現期，其中八成四更精確地對應昏星初現；日期亦偏聚在十一月到翌年一月的乾季，播種期罕見，豐收期（九月中至十月底）完全沒有星戰。部分蒂卡爾的星戰緊接日蝕之後，另有不少與火星、木星、土星的逆行期重疊。781年3月31日落在乾季末梢，與整體分布一致。
戰法上，這類戰爭重的是速度與突然：斥候先行，隊伍沿河谷與獸道推進，接近後由擲矛手與弓箭手先擾，貴族戰士穿棉甲、戴面具、插羽飾，君主與旗手押在己陣中央。奪城之後常見的是毀碑、拆屋、燒毀對方標誌性的立柱，以抹去對方王朝的合法性；另有一種只為捉人不為殺人的「花戰」（xochiyao），用於對付不想殺死的同族。皮達斯內格拉斯能維持數百年的走廊控制，靠的正是這套節奏。
tacticsEn:
For the Maya a star war was a set-piece engagement whose outcome was expected to be final. Priests of the royal court first fixed the day of departure from the Venus tables and the Long Count; the king then marched with the lineages of his own city and the contingents of his subordinate towns, following a fixed route into the enemy's territory, aiming to settle the matter in one action either in the open field or before the walls, to take the opposing ruler captive, and afterwards to raise a stela recording the result and to open a new era.
The choice of the day was not arbitrary. Venus was called the Great Star, Chak Ek', in Mesoamerica, and was the bringer of war; the Venus pages of the Dresden Codex set out the morning and evening appearances of the planet in cycles of eighty-four days, and together with the computations of the calendrical house they determined which days could be used for war. Statistically, about seventy per cent of the recorded star war dates fall in the evening phase of Venus, and eighty-four per cent of those correspond to the first appearance of the evening star. The dates cluster in the dry season from November to January; they are rare in the planting season and entirely absent from the harvest period, between mid-September and late October. Some Tikal star wars came only a day after a solar eclipse, and many others coincide with the retrograde periods of Mars, Jupiter and Saturn. The 31st of March 781 falls at the end of the dry season, in line with the general pattern.
In tactical terms these wars prized speed and surprise. Scouts went ahead, columns advanced along the river valleys and game trails, and once contact was made the dart-throwers and archers harried the enemy first, while elite warriors came on in quilted cotton, masks and feathers, the king and the standard-bearer held in the middle of the line. After a city was taken, the usual practice was to break stelae, pull down buildings and burn the marker columns that carried the defeated dynasty's legitimacy; there was also a form of war fought only to capture and not to kill, the flower war, xochiyao, used against kin whom one did not wish to destroy. This tempo is what allowed Piedras Negras to hold the western corridor for centuries.
data:
這場戰爭能被寫下的數字不多，但每個都有出處。日期是公元781年3月31日，長紀曆9.17.10.6.1，即瑪雅有碑銘記錄的第十三次星際大戰，也是有紀錄的最後一次。皮達斯內格拉斯新王基尼奇·亞特·阿克二世的即位長紀為9.17.10.9.4，比星戰晚六十三天，約在同年六月初。學者統計的星戰日期共十三個，自562年4月29日（蒂卡爾敗於卡拉科爾）至781年3月31日為止：其間562年那一役令蒂卡爾的紀念碑停建達一百二十年，631年納蘭霍王被卡拉克穆爾擒去，644年托爾圖格羅的石碑記下「血聚成池」，670年多斯皮拉斯打敗蒂卡爾，705年多斯皮拉斯再勝蒂卡爾，711年蒂卡爾反攻多斯皮拉斯，735年多斯皮拉斯滅塞伊瓦爾，762年納蘭霍又毀蒂卡爾王統。
皮達斯內格拉斯主城在八世紀後半人口估計約二千六百人，整個政體的人口估計約五萬；遺址自七世紀延續到公元850年，雕塑與建築最盛的一段是608至810年。亞什奇蘭與皮達斯內格拉斯相距約四十公里，沿同一條烏蘇馬辛塔河。808年皮達斯內格拉斯王被擒，王朝終結，城址最遲在930年前後廢棄。至於781年那一戰的俘獲人數、行程日數與雙方損耗，碑文沒有留下任何數字，只留下勝負與日期。
dataEn:
Few numbers survive for this war, but each of them has a source. The date is 31 March 781, Long Count 9.17.10.6.1, the thirteenth star war in the Maya epigraphic record and the last one of any. The accession of the new ruler of Piedras Negras, K'inich Yat Ahk II, is dated 9.17.10.9.4, sixty-three days after the star war, in early June of the same year. Thirteen star war dates are known in total, running from 29 April 562, when Tikal was defeated by Caracol, to 31 March 781. In between: the defeat of 562 halted monument building at Tikal for a hundred and twenty years; the ruler of Naranjo was taken by Calakmul in 631; the Tortuguero stela of 644 recorded that the blood was pooled; Dos Pilas defeated Tikal in 670 and again in 705; Tikal counter-attacked Dos Pilas in 711; Dos Pilas absorbed Seibal in 735; and Naranjo broke the Tikal dynasty in 762.
The main settlement of Piedras Negras is estimated at about 2,600 people at its peak in the second half of the eighth century, and the whole polity at roughly 50,000. Occupation of the site runs from the seventh century BC to AD 850, and its finest sculpture and architecture belong to the span from 608 to 810. Yaxchilan lies some forty kilometres from Piedras Negras, on the same Usumacinta. In 808 the king of Piedras Negras was captured, the dynasty ended, and the site was abandoned by about 930. As for the number of captives taken, the days spent on the march and the losses on both sides in the war of 781, the inscriptions preserve nothing: only the result and the date.
cause:
要理解781年這場星戰為何會打起來，先要看星戰在古典期瑪雅世界裡的制度功能。每一場被記為星戰的戰役，都意味著一方政權被另一方判定為徹底失敗，隨之而來的是王朝更替、統治權轉移，或是一個長期臣屬的城邦宣告獨立。星戰因此不只是軍事事件，它是王權合法性的來源：勝者靠它立碑、開國，新王靠它登基。
皮達斯內格拉斯這時正處在王位交替的節點。哈·金·索克在780年退位，基尼奇·亞特·阿克二世隨後即位；新王需要一場決定性的勝利來為新王朝奠基，於是把目標對準西部走廊上的一個無名鄰邦，用一場星戰替換掉舊的紀元。
更大的背景是南方低地的崩解。蒂卡爾在762年被納蘭霍打垮，多斯皮拉斯在729年後失去蒂卡爾的宗主地位，塞伊瓦爾在735年被吞併，佩滕北部的權力真空讓亞什奇蘭與皮達斯內格拉斯這些河谷城邦迅速上升。而星戰的時機並非純粹政治算計：金星表的推算給出「可開戰」的日子，祭司把天文曆法與政治需要對接起來，定出一個既能動員又能儀式化的時點。於是八世紀末的西部瑪雅世界，便在金星週期與王位交替的交會處，打了最隆重的一仗。
causeEn:
To understand why the star war of 781 was fought, one has to see what the star war meant as an institution in the Classic Maya world. Every conflict recorded with the star glyph meant that one polity had been judged by another to be utterly defeated, and that dynasty change, transfer of rule, or the declaration of independence by a long-subordinated city-state would follow. A star war was therefore not merely a military event but the source of royal legitimacy: the victor raised stelae and founded a polity upon it, and a new king ascended on the strength of it.
Piedras Negras stood at a point of dynastic transition. Ha' K'in Xook abdicated in 780 and K'inich Yat Ahk II succeeded him; the new king needed a decisive victory to found a new house, and so he set his target at an unnamed neighbour in the western corridor, using a star war to replace the old era.
The larger background was the unraveling of the southern lowlands. Tikal was broken by Naranjo in 762, Dos Pilas had lost its overlordship at Tikal after 729, Seibal was absorbed in 735, and the power vacuum in northern Petén let river-valley cities such as Yaxchilan and Piedras Negras rise quickly. Nor was the timing of a star war a matter of pure political arithmetic: the Venus tables produced the days on which war might be opened, and the priests welded astronomy and calendar onto political necessity, fixing a moment that could both mobilise men and be solemnised by ritual. Thus it was in the meeting place of a Venus cycle and a change of ruler that the western Maya world fought its grandest war of the eighth century.
impact:
781年3月31日這場星戰，在瑪雅世界留下的最大影響，是它本身成了句點：它是有碑銘可查的最後一場星際大戰。此後再沒有任何一座古典期城邦以星戰的形式記錄勝負，同類記載在八世紀末之後完全中斷。經典期的瑪雅城邦體系並非在此日崩解，但舊的競爭機制確實在此後二十多年內失效：皮達斯內格拉斯自身在787年打敗聖埃萊娜、又與波莫納開戰，走到808年被亞什奇蘭王基尼奇·塔布·頭骨擒住，603年起的王朝斷續，亞什奇蘭也在九世紀末衰敗，佩滕地區在930年前後人去城空。學界早期所謂「古典期崩潰」，其實是一個長達百年的分段過程，781年之後中美洲再也沒有出現同類的宏大對決。
另一層影響在學術史。皮達斯內格拉斯成排的碑刻保存了完整的王表，正是它讓塔蒂亞娜·普洛斯庫里亞科夫在1960年代重排出瑪雅王朝的年代，奠定今日解讀銘文的基礎；她提出的建城、紀年、聯姻、戰俘、覆亡等事件框架，讓星際大戰有了可考的年表，也讓這場連敵國名字都沒有留下的戰爭，成為觀察勝利者如何書寫歷史的樣本。
impactEn:
The greatest consequence of the star war of 31 March 781 was that it was itself a full stop: it is the last star war for which inscriptions survive. No Classic Maya city-state ever again recorded a result in the form of a star war, and the genre disappears completely from the epigraphic record after the end of the eighth century. The Classic system of Maya city-states did not collapse on that day, but the old mechanism of competition did cease to work within a generation or two: Piedras Negras itself defeated Santa Elena in 787 and went on fighting Pomoná, yet by 808 its king had been taken by K'inich Tatb'u Skull of Yaxchilan and the dynasty founded in 603 was broken; Yaxchilan itself declined by the end of the ninth century, and the Petén region stood empty by about 930. What was long called the Classic Maya collapse turns out to be a segmented process spread across a century; after 781 Mesoamerica never again staged a comparable confrontation.
There is a second layer of consequence, in the history of scholarship. The rows of stelae at Piedras Negras preserve an essentially complete royal sequence, and it was that corpus which allowed Tatiana Proskouriakoff in the 1960s to reconstruct the chronology of Maya dynasties and so laid the foundation for the way inscriptions are read today. Her scheme of events — foundation, period-ending, accession, capture of war, downfall — gave the star war a datable framework, and turned this war, in which even the enemy's name was not written down, into a standard case for studying how victors write history.
result:
結果很簡單：皮達斯內格拉斯贏了。781年3月31日，長紀曆9.17.10.6.1這一天被記成一次星戰，勝者是皮達斯內格拉斯，敗者是一個在碑文中連名字都沒有留下的政權。依星戰一貫的樣式，敗方應當付出君主被俘、標誌被毀、紀年被改的代價：皮達斯內格拉斯在星戰之後六十三天為新王舉行即位儀式，接著在785年立下「王座一」，把這次勝利鑄進王朝的正統之中。
這場勝利的直接後果，是皮達斯內格拉斯在八世紀末確立了對烏蘇馬辛塔河中上游的主導權：它與亞什奇蘭結盟，同亞什奇蘭共享上游航線，又以這場戰役清除了身後的一個競爭者。從王位交替的角度看，基尼奇·亞特·阿克二世由此把建國的合法性建立在戰爭之上——這正是星戰的用意：不是單純滅掉對手，而是讓自己的紀年從此有了開端。
從更長的視角看，781年這場星戰是古典期瑪雅秩序的收尾而非轉折。此後二十七年，皮達斯內格拉斯還在打贏聖埃萊娜、還在與波莫納爭地；然而再往後，這種以星戰定輸贏的政治競爭再也沒有出現在碑刻上，直到有文字的瑪雅世界換了另一種寫法。
resultEn:
The result is simple: Piedras Negras won. On 31 March 781, Long Count 9.17.10.6.1, the day was recorded as a star war, the victor being Piedras Negras and the defeated a polity whose name was never written down even on its own monuments. Following the established pattern of star wars, the loser paid in the capture of its ruler, the destruction of its markers and the replacement of its calendar: sixty-three days after the star war Piedras Negras held the accession rite of the new king, and in 785 set up Throne 1, casting the victory into the legitimacy of the dynasty.
The immediate consequence of that victory was that Piedras Negras confirmed its primacy over the middle and upper Usumacinta at the end of the eighth century: it entered into alliance with Yaxchilan and shared the upriver route with it, while removing one competitor behind its own position. From the point of view of the succession, K'inich Yat Ahk II thus built the legitimacy of his new house on a war, which is precisely the purpose of a star war: not merely to destroy an opponent, but to give one's own reckoning a beginning.
Seen from further off, the star war of 781 is a closing rather than a turning point of the Classic Maya order. For twenty-seven years afterwards Piedras Negras went on winning at Santa Elena and on fighting Pomoná for land. Yet from then on this kind of political competition, settled by the star war, never appeared on the monuments again, until the literate Maya world found another way to write.
